latin: Qui nescierit perfecte sensibiles proprietates per uiam secretae analogiae intellectualizare, nihil ex hymnis Orphei sanum intelliget.
translation: Whoever does not know how to intellectualize perfectly the sensible properties by way of secret analogy will understand nothing sound from the Hymns of Orpheus.
